name: Octal Credit Capital Limited
about: Octal Credit Capital Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the loan financing and trading in shares and securities activities in India. It offers corporate and personal loans, as well as invests and trades in shares and securities. The company was formerly known as Octal Economic Consultants Private Limited and changed its name to Octal Credit Capital Limited in September 1994. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Kolkata, India.
